integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, cool-toned dark interior with soft round bokeh lights behind her, a face close-up frames the young woman shown in <Picture 1>, preserving her exact silver-grey long straight hair with blunt bangs and long side strands, the fluffy white cat-ear headband with pink inner ears, the draped pearl strands and the small pink cat-shaped clip above her right brow, the silver clip and pearls on her left side, her large grey eyes with wet highlights and long lower lashes, the deep pink blush on both cheeks, the tiny star-shaped glitter under her eyes, her glossy half-parted pink lips, her bare shoulders and the iridescent sequin top, and the dark blurred background with its round out-of-focus light spots. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed while she keeps both palms pressed against her cheeks, tilts her head to one side, blinks slowly once and lets a small closed-lip smile open. She then slides both hands off her face and lifts them into curled cat-paw fists beside her jaw, rocks her head lightly from side to side twice and snaps her eyes wide open. She finishes by bending both index fingers and thumbs into a small heart shape in front of her chin, puffs her cheeks out, then releases the pose and laughs with her eyes curved into crescents and her head still slightly tilted. Her hair, cat ears, pearl clips and the bokeh lights keep the same shape, color and position throughout, and her shoulders stay almost still while only her hands, head and face move.

overall_soundscape: The dark space stays quiet and low with a faint outdoor night ambience underneath. Her light giggle and a short soft breath carry the beat, layered with the small clink of the pearl hair clips and the rustle of long hair and slippery sequin fabric as she moves her hands.

non_diegetic_music: A bright kawaii track at a moderate tempo built on a glockenspiel melody, plucked toy-piano notes and a soft hand-clap rhythm, with a rising two-note accent under each new pose before the melody thins out into a single fading bell.
